description: This file defines the LeavePeriodModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin API. It acts as a data representation (model) for a leave period, serializing its start and end dates for API responses. The class uses traits and interfaces for serialization and normalization, and is constructed with a LeavePeriod data object.

classes.name: LeavePeriodModel
classes.description: A model class representing a leave period with start and end dates, serializable for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a LeavePeriod DTO, setting serialization filters and attribute names.
